theorem X (α : Type u_4) [self : Bornology α] : Bornology.cobounded α ≤ Filter.cofinite := by
  have h₁ : False := by
    classical
    -- Prove that α is nonempty to derive a contradiction.
    have h₂ : Nonempty α := by
      exact inferInstance
    -- Obtain an element `a` from the nonempty set `α`.
    obtain ⟨a⟩ := h₂
    -- Use the properties of the bornology to derive a contradiction.
    have h₃ := self.bddAbove (Set.univ : Set α)
    have h₄ := self.bddBelow (Set.univ : Set α)
    -- Simplify the conditions obtained from the bornology.
    simp at h₃ h₄
    <;>
    (try contradiction) <;>
    (try aesop) <;>
    (try norm_num) <;>
    (try linarith)
    <;>
    aesop
  
  have h₂ : Bornology.cobounded α ≤ Filter.cofinite := by
    exfalso
    exact h₁
  
  exact h₂
